breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg/2)² + τ_avg²), which includes both the normal stress contribution (σ_avg/2 = 3.125 MPa) and the shear stress contribution (τ_avg = 2.5 MPa). This matches the ground truth formula and does not ignore the normal stress contribution as the incomplete prompt suggested. The final result of 4.002 MPa reflects both components properly.
